# Zoom-shaped fixtures

Synthetic files with the exact shape of a Zoom transcript export: optional notes,
then cues of a `HH:MM:SS --> HH:MM:SS` line, a `Label: text` line and a blank
line (a cue may hold several speakers, one per line), with no WEBVTT header and no cue numbers. `notes.txt` has the notes,
`plain.txt` starts at the first cue. Four labels, one of them `Unknown`. The names
are invented. The last cue holds two speakers on two lines, as one cue in a real
export does.
